content: eBay Pokemon listings: 'lot'/'bundle' listings race to the bottom on price and are not representative of single-item value; counterfeit/reprint Pokemon card and product fakes are rising sharply (PSA fraud reports) and are sometimes mislabeled as OFFICIAL/genuine in titles; damaged/opened/resealed product also appears in title text as caveats. All of these must be filtered out of true per-product price aggregation or they skew price trends low/high.
